decision: Start from pinned main and create codex/apple-silicon-story-tracer
why: Remote main exactly matched build contract; no user delta existed
evidence: GitHub branch API plus local git status/rev-parse

decision: Treat local run as source-only until arm64 macOS 26 evidence exists
why: Runtime is Linux x86_64 with no Swift or Clang

decision: Use one TypeScript kernel bundle inside host-owned serial JavaScriptCore adapter
why: Smallest accepted adapter keeps Deck semantics outside WebView and has a documented replacement seam

decision: Use no third-party production runtime packages
why: Tracer needs only Apple frameworks and Node built-ins for generation/tests

decision: Retain full hash-chained journal after atomic checkpoints in tracer
why: Avoid unsafe compaction while preserving durable history and restart replay

decision: Fix StateObject initialization before changing architecture
why: arm64 compiler reached one exact autoclosure error; kernel and shell boundaries were not implicated

decision: Use explicit tracer process exit and bounded watchdog
why: Native build passed; packaged process remained live after launch with no completed receipt
result: termination made deterministic; runtime diagnostics added

decision: Launch headless packaged tracer from explicit AppKit delegate rather than SwiftUI view task
why: Second bounded run remained before tracer receipt; compile/sign were already green
result: root launch seam replaced; normal GUI remains SwiftUI
